survivors.replacement: return model.replace(model) if start[0] > 1 else model
survivors.description: Skips recursive position filling for models starting on the first line.
survivors.diff:
--- a/hy/reader/hy_reader.py
+++ b/hy/reader/hy_reader.py
@@ -130,3 +130,3 @@
         model.end_line, model.end_column = self.pos
-        return model.replace(model)
+        return model.replace(model) if start[0] > 1 else model
           # `replace` will recurse into submodels and set any model
